checks.name: seeded_rows

checks.name: unauthenticated_blocked
checks.description: Record list and N+1 endpoints return 401 without a session cookie

checks.name: login_sets_httponly_session_cookie
checks.description: Login sets an HttpOnly cookie whose value is an opaque token stored in the sessions table
checks.evidence: login=200, HttpOnly=True, opaque=True, token_len=43, row_in_sessions=1, wrong_password=401

checks.name: crud_roundtrip
checks.description: POST -> GET by id -> PUT -> GET all -> DELETE -> GET 404 on /api/records

checks.description: 5 record ids drawn with VERIFY_SEED are readable via GET /api/records/{id}

checks.name: logout_revokes_session

checks.name: raw_nplus1_180_requests
